# htop

![Screenshot of htop](docs/images/screenshot.png?raw=true)

## Introduction

`htop` is a cross-platform interactive process viewer.

`htop` allows scrolling the list of processes vertically and horizontally to see their full command lines and related information like memory and CPU consumption.
Also system wide information, like load average or swap usage, is shown.

The information displayed is configurable through a graphical setup and can be sorted and filtered interactively.

Tasks related to processes (e.g. killing and renicing) can be done without entering their PIDs.

For more information and details visit [htop.dev](https://htop.dev).

## Usage

See the manual page (`man htop`) or the help menu (`h` or `F1` inside `htop`) for a list of supported key commands.

### Quick Start

Some common actions to get you started with `htop`:

- Search processes: press `/`
- Filter processes: press `\`
- Toggle tree view: press `t`
- Change process sort column: press `.`
- Kill a process: select the process and press `k`

## Command-Line Options

- `-d DELAY` : Delay between updates, in tenths of a second
- `-C` : Start in monochrome mode
- `-F` : Filter by command name
- `-h` : Display help and exit
- `-p PID[,PID...]` : Show only the given PIDs
- `-s COLUMN` : Sort by specified column
- `-t` : Start in tree view mode
- `-u USERNAME` : Show only processes of a given user
- `-v` : Print version and exit
- `-H` : Show threads

## pcp-htop

`pcp-htop` is a version of `htop` built using the Performance Co-Pilot (PCP) Metrics API, allowing display of values from arbitrary metrics.

Once again, these metrics must be named (the same rules
described above for meters apply here) and the following
properties can be configured:
.TP 5
.B name.metric
This is the only mandatory field and associates a PCP metric
with the meter.
Values sampled for each metric at runtime provide the
animation visible in the
.B pcp-htop
display.
The metric specification can be either a PCP metric name as
listed by
.BR pminfo (1)
or a "derived" metric expression.
The format for derived metric expressions is described on the
.BR pmRegisterDerived (3)
manual page.
.TP
.B name.color
Setting color to be used when rendering metric values.
Possible values are
.IR red ,
.IR green ,
.IR blue ,
.IR cyan ,
.IR magenta ,
.IR yellow ,
.IR gray ,
.I darkgray
or
.IR white .
.TP
.B name.label
An optional, short label to display before the metric value.
The ":" character will be appended to the
.I label
before the metric value part of the display.
.TP
.B name.suffix
An optional, short suffix to display after the metric value.
Commonly used to indicate values as a percentage using a "%"
.I suffix
value and to provide the base unit of measurement.
Note that since PCP maintains units for metrics, for those
metrics that have dimension in "space" (bytes, kilobytes,
megabytes, etc), a suffix will be automatically appended.
.SH "COLUMNS"
The following is an example configuration for a new column
showing open file descriptors for each process:
.LP
.ft CR
.nf
.in +0.5i
[openfds]
heading = FDS
caption = FDCOUNT
description = Open file descriptors
metric = proc.fd.count
width = 3
.in
.fi
.ft 1
.LP
A configuration file can contain multiple column definitions.
Each definition begins with a identifying name enclosed
by square brackets \-
.I openfds
in this example, and the same rules apply as described above
for meter names.
.LP
Each column must specify a metric.
Optional parameters can also be set.
.TP 5
.B metric
As with meters, the metric value must be either a PCP metric
name as listed by
.BR pminfo (1)
or a derived metric.
The metric must have an instance domain (set of values) and
that instance domain must map to the set of processes with
the instance identifier being PIDs (process identifiers).
Typically this will be metrics from the
.I proc
or
.I hotproc
namespace (\c
.BR pmdaproc (1)),
but metrics from other domains (\c
.BR pmdabpf (1),
etc) that have per-process values are equally applicable.
.TP
.B width
Column width to use when displaying values for the metric.
A negative value can be used to specify left alignment.
An upper column limit of 28 characters is enforced.
The default column width is 5 characters.
.TP
.B heading
The short title that will be displayed at the head of the
column \- usually a short, cryptic, all uppercase string.
.TP
.B caption
A short identifying word presented to users on the Setup
screen under both the Available and Active Columns lists.
.TP
.B description
Text that assists users to understand the meaning of this
column when it is being presented via the Setup screen in
the Available Columns list.
.SH "SEE ALSO"

</output_tail>

    elif canonical == "filter":
        set_filter(opts, arg if arg is not None else "")
    elif canonical == "no-function-bar":

def long_matches(name: str):
    raw = [(canon, longname, kind) for canon, longname, kind, _ in LONG_OPTIONS if longname.startswith(name)]

    exact = [m for m in raw if m[1] == name]
    if exact:
        raw = exact
    # Options that share the same canonical action are aliases and not ambiguous.
    canons = []
    for c, _l, _k in raw:
        if c not in canons:
            canons.append(c)
    return raw, canons

    vals = [longname for _c, longname, _k, _s in LONG_OPTIONS if longname.startswith(name)]
    if name in ("n", "no", "no-") or name.startswith("no-"):
        ordered = [x for x in AMBIG_ORDER if x in vals]
        rest = [x for x in vals if x not in ordered]
        return ordered + rest
    return vals


def resolve_long(argv0: str, token: str):
    body = token[2:]
    if "=" in body:

        has_attached = True
    else:
        name, attached = body, None
        has_attached = False
    raw, canons = long_matches(name)
    if not raw:
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: unrecognized option '{token}'")
    if len(canons) > 1:
        poss = " ".join(f"'--{x}'" for x in ambiguity_list(name))
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option '{token}' is ambiguous; possibilities: {poss}")
    # Prefer exact/first spelling for diagnostics.
    canon = canons[0]
    selected = raw[0]
    # If several aliases match, use exact if present otherwise first listed.
    for m in raw:
        if m[1] == name:
            selected = m
            break
    _canon, longname, kind = selected
    if has_attached and kind == 0:
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option '--{longname}' doesn't allow an argument")

                        consumed_next = True
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    canon = {"d": "delay", "F": "filter", "n": "max-iterations", "p": "pid", "s": "sort-key"}[ch]
                    apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
                    continue
                if ch in "Hu":
                    if pos + 1 < len(cluster):
                        arg = cluster[pos + 1:]
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    elif i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                        i += 1
                        arg = argv[i]
                        consumed_next = True
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    else:
                        arg = None
                        pos += 1
                    canon = {"H": "highlight-changes", "u": "user"}[ch]
                    apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
                    continue
            i += 1
            continue
        nonopts.append(a)
        i += 1
    return opts, nonopts


def check_terminal() -> bool:
    term = os.environ.get("TERM") or "unknown"
    return term != "unknown"


def color(opts: Opts, code: str, text: str) -> str:
    if opts.no_color:
        return text
    return f"\033[{code}m{text}\033[39m"


def attr(opts: Opts, code: str, text: str) -> str:
    if opts.no_color:
        return text
    return f"\033[{code}m{text}\033[0m"


def read_meminfo():
    vals = {}
    try:
        with open("/proc/meminfo", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    vals[parts[0].rstrip(":")] = int(parts[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    total = vals.get("MemTotal", 0)
    avail = vals.get("MemAvailable", vals.get("MemFree", 0))
    used = max(0, total - avail)
    swapt = vals.get("SwapTotal", 0)
    swapf = vals.get("SwapFree", 0)
    swapu = max(0, swapt - swapf)
    return total, used, swapt, swapu


def human_k(kb: int) -> str:
    if kb >= 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{kb / (1024*1024):.1f}T" if kb >= 1024*1024*1024 else f"{kb/(1024*1024):.1f}G"
    if kb >= 1024:
        return f"{kb/1024:.1f}G" if kb >= 1024*1024 else f"{kb//1024}M"
    return f"{kb}K"


def compact_k(kb: int) -> str:
    if kb < 100000:
        return str(kb)
    if kb < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{kb//1024}M"
    return f"{kb/(1024*1024):.1f}G"


def uptime_text() -> str:
    try:
        secs = int(float(open("/proc/uptime", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()[0]))
    except Exception:
        secs = 0
    days, rem = divmod(secs, 86400)
    h, rem = divmod(rem, 3600)
    m, _s = divmod(rem, 60)
    if days:
        return f"{days} days, {h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"


def loadavg_text() -> str:
    try:
        p = open("/proc/loadavg", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()
        return f"{float(p[0]):.2f} {float(p[1]):.2f} {float(p[2]):.2f}"
    except Exception:
        return "0.00 0.00 0.00"


def pid_filter_set(raw: str | None):
    if raw is None:
        return None
    out = set()
    for item in raw.split(','):
        try:
            if item.strip():
                out.add(int(item))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return out


def parse_stat(pid: int):
    data = open(f"/proc/{pid}/stat", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    r = data.rfind(")")
    l = data.find("(")
    comm = data[l+1:r] if l != -1 and r != -1 else str(pid)
    parts = data[r+2:].split()
    return comm, parts


def read_status_uid(pid: int):
    try:
        with open(f"/proc/{pid}/status", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.startswith("Uid:"):
                    return int(line.split()[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    return -1


def username(uid: int) -> str:
    try:
        return pwd.getpwuid(uid).pw_name[:8]
    except Exception:
        return str(uid)[:8]


def cmdline(pid: int, comm: str) -> str:
    try:
        b = open(f"/proc/{pid}/cmdline", "rb").read()
        if b:
            return b.replace(b"\0", b" ").decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return comm


def time_field(ticks: int) -> str:
    hz = os.sysconf(os.sysconf_names.get('SC_CLK_TCK', 'SC_CLK_TCK')) if hasattr(os, 'sysconf') else 100
    hundredths = int(ticks * 100 / (hz or 100))
    sec = hundredths // 100
    hs = hundredths % 100
    m, s = divmod(sec, 60)
    h, m = divmod(m, 60)
    if h:
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
    return f"{m}:{s:02d}.{hs:02d}"


def collect_processes(opts: Opts):
    pfilter = pid_filter_set(opts.pids_raw)
    total_mem, _used, _swapt, _swapu = read_meminfo()
    pagesize = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE") // 1024
    rows = []
    for name in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not name.isdigit():
            continue
        pid = int(name)
        if pfilter is not None and pid not in pfilter:
            continue
        try:
            comm, st = parse_stat(pid)
            state = st[0]
            ppid = int(st[1])
            priority = int(st[15])
            nice = int(st[16])
            threads = int(st[17])
            utime = int(st[11]); stime = int(st[12])
            vsize_kb = int(st[20]) // 1024
            rss_kb = int(st[21]) * pagesize
            statm = open(f"/proc/{pid}/statm", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()
            shr_kb = int(statm[2]) * pagesize if len(statm) > 2 else 0
            uid = read_status_uid(pid)
            if opts.uid is not None and uid != opts.uid:
                continue
            command = cmdline(pid, comm)
            if opts.filter:
                terms = [t.lower() for t in opts.filter.split('|') if t]
                if terms and not any(t in command.lower() for t in terms):
                    continue
            mempct = (rss_kb / total_mem * 100.0) if total_mem else 0.0
            rows.append({
                "pid": pid, "ppid": ppid, "user": username(uid), "pri": priority,
                "nice": nice, "virt": vsize_kb, "res": rss_kb, "shr": shr_kb,
                "state": state, "cpu": 0.0, "mem": mempct,
                "time": time_field(utime + stime), "command": command,
                "threads": threads,
            })
        except Exception:
            continue
    key = opts.sort_key or "PID"
    if key == "PERCENT_MEM":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["mem"], r["pid"]))
    elif key in ("PERCENT_CPU", "PERCENT_NORM_CPU"):
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["cpu"], r["pid"]))
    elif key == "USER":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["user"], r["pid"]))
    elif key == "Command":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["command"].lower(), r["pid"]))
    elif key == "TIME":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["time"], r["pid"]))
    else:
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["pid"])
    return rows


def process_counts(rows):
    tasks = len(rows)
    running = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("state") == "R")
    threads = sum(max(0, r.get("threads", 1) - 1) for r in rows)
    return tasks, threads, running


def strip_ansi_len(s: str) -> int:
    n = 0; esc = False; bracket = False
    for ch in s:
        if esc:
            if bracket:
                if ch.isalpha() or ch in "@`~":
                    esc = bracket = False
            else:
                if ch == '[':
                    bracket = True
                else:
                    esc = False
        elif ch == '\033':
            esc = True
        else:
            n += 1
    return n


def pad_cut(s: str, width: int) -> str:
    # Keep it simple: process rows have no ANSI sequences.
    if len(s) > width:
        return s[:width]
    return s + " " * (width - len(s))


def bar(percent: float, width: int, opts: Opts) -> str:
    filled = max(0, min(width, int(width * percent / 100.0)))
    ch = "|" if not opts.no_unicode else "#"
    empty = " " * (width - filled)
    return color(opts, "32", ch * filled) + (color(opts, "30;1", empty) if not opts.no_color else empty)


def render_frame(opts: Opts, rows, frame_no: int) -> str:
    cols, lines = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
    if cols < 40:
        cols = 80
    out = []
    out.append("\033[H")
    out.append("\033[J")
    total, used, swapt, swapu = read_meminfo()
    tasks, threads, running = process_counts(rows)
    line_no = 1
    if not opts.no_meters:
        cpu_pct = 0.0
        try:
            la = float(open("/proc/loadavg", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()[0])
            cpus = os.cpu_count() or 1
            cpu_pct = max(0.0, min(100.0, la * 100.0 / cpus))
        except Exception:
            pass
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Avg')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(cpu_pct, 28, opts)}{cpu_pct:4.1f}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Tasks: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(tasks))}{color(opts,'36',', ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(threads))}{color(opts,'36',' thr')}{color(opts,'36',f'; ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(running))}{color(opts,'36',' running')}\033[K\n")
        mempct = used * 100.0 / total if total else 0.0
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Mem')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(mempct, 28, opts)}{human_k(used)}/{human_k(total)}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Load average: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',loadavg_text())}\033[K\n")
        swppct = swapu * 100.0 / swapt if swapt else 0.0
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Swp')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(swppct, 28, opts)}{human_k(swapu)}/{human_k(swapt)}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Uptime: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',uptime_text())}\033[K\n")
        out.append("\033[K\n")
        line_no = 5
    if not opts.no_function_bar:
        out.append(f"  {attr(opts,'32;42','[Main]')} {attr(opts,'34;44','[I/O]')}\033[K\n")
        line_no += 1
    sortmark = "-" if (opts.sort_key in (None, "PERCENT_CPU")) else "+"
    header = f"  PID USER       PRI  NI  VIRT   RES   SHR S  CPU%{sortmark}MEM%   TIME+  Command"
    if opts.no_color:
        out.append(pad_cut(header, cols) + "\n")
    else:
        out.append("\033[30;42m" + pad_cut(header, cols) + "\033[39;49m\n")
    max_rows = lines - line_no - (2 if not opts.no_function_bar else 1)
    if max_rows < 1:
        max_rows = 1
    for idx, r in enumerate(rows[:max_rows]):
        cmd = r['command']
        if opts.tree and r['ppid'] != 0:
            cmd = ("`- " if opts.no_unicode else "└─ ") + cmd
        line = (f"{r['pid']:5d} {r['user']:<8.8s} {r['pri']:4d} {r['nice']:3d} "
                f"{compact_k(r['virt']):>5.5s} {compact_k(r['res']):>5.5s} {compact_k(r['shr']):>5.5s} "
                f"{r['state']:<1s} {r['cpu']:5.1f} {r['mem']:4.1f} {r['time']:>8.8s}  {cmd}")
        line = pad_cut(line, cols)
        if idx == 0 and not opts.no_color:
            out.append("\033[30;46m" + line + "\033[39;49m\n")
        else:
            out.append(line + "\n")
    if not opts.no_function_bar:
        # Position a htop-style function bar at the last line.
        out.append(f"\033[{lines};1H")
        labels = [("F1","Help"),("F2","Setup"),("F3","Search"),("F4","Filter"),("F5","Tree"),("F6","SortBy"),("F7","Nice -"),("F8","Nice +"),("F9","Kill"),("F10","Quit")]
        fb = ""
        for f, lab in labels:
            if opts.no_color:
                fb += f"{f}{lab} "
            else:
                fb += f"\033[30;46m{f}\033[39;49m\033[34;47m{lab}\033[39;49m"
        out.append(pad_cut(fb, cols))
    out.append("\033[H")
    return "".join(out)


def render_help_screen(opts: Opts) -> str:
    cols, lines = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
    text = [
        "htop Help", "", "Available keys:",
        "  F1 h ?   Show this help screen", "  q F10    Quit",
        "  F5 t     Tree view", "  F6 .     Sort by column", "",
        "Press q or Escape to return.", "", VERSION,
    ]
    out = ["\033[H\033[J"]
    for line in text[:lines-1]:
        out.append(pad_cut(line, cols) + "\n")
    return "".join(out)


def terminal_main(opts: Opts) -> int:
    if not check_terminal():
        eprint("Error opening terminal: unknown.")
        return 1
    delay_s = max(0.1, min(10.0, opts.delay / 10.0))
    iterations = opts.max_iterations
    interactive = sys.stdin.isatty()
    old_term = None
    if interactive:
        try:
            old_term = termios.tcgetattr(sys.stdin.fileno())
            tty.setcbreak(sys.stdin.fileno())
        except Exception:
            old_term = None
    try:
        sys.stdout.write("\033[?1049h\033[22;0;0t\033[1;24r\033(B\033[m\033[4l\033[?7h\033[H\033[2J\033[?1h\033=\033[?25l\033[39;49m")
        if not opts.no_mouse:
            sys.stdout.write("\033[?1006;1000h")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        frame = 0
        help_mode = False
        while True:
            frame += 1
            if help_mode:
                sys.stdout.write(render_help_screen(opts))
            else:
                rows = collect_processes(opts)
                sys.stdout.write(render_frame(opts, rows, frame))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            if iterations is not None and frame >= iterations:
                break
            end = time.time() + delay_s
            while True:
                timeout = max(0.0, end - time.time())
                if interactive:
                    try:
                        r, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], min(timeout, 0.1))
                    except Exception:
                        r = []
                    if r:
                        ch = os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 16).decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
                        if ch in ('q', 'Q') or ch.endswith('q') or ch == '\x1b[21~':
                            return 0
                        if ch in ('h', '?', '\x1bOP') or ch.startswith('\x1bOP'):
                            help_mode = not help_mode
                            break
                        if help_mode and ('\x1b' in ch or 'q' in ch):
                            help_mode = False
                            break
                        if 't' in ch:
                            opts.tree = not opts.tree
                            break
                else:
                    time.sleep(timeout)
                if time.time() >= end:
                    break
        return 0
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 0
    finally:
        try:
            sys.stdout.write("\033[?12l\033[?25h")
            if not opts.no_mouse:
                sys.stdout.write("\033[?1006;1000l")
            sys.stdout.write("\033[24;1H\n\033[?1l\033>\033[?1049l\033[23;0;0t")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if old_term is not None:
            try:
                termios.tcsetattr(sys.stdin.fileno(), termios.TCSADRAIN, old_term)
            except Exception:
                pass


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        opts, nonopts = parse_args(argv)
        if nonopts:
            raise CliError("Error: unsupported non-option ARGV-elements: " + " ".join(nonopts))
        return terminal_main(opts)
    except ImmediateExit as ex:
        return ex.code
    except CliError as ex:
        eprint(str(ex))
        return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

        i = 1
    if i >= len(text) or not text[i].isdigit():
        return None
    j = i
    while j < len(text) and text[j].isdigit():
        j += 1
    try:
        return int(text[:j])
    except Exception:
        return None


def set_delay(opts: Opts, value: str) -> None:
    v = parse_initial_int(value)
    if v is None:
        raise CliError(f'Error: invalid delay value "{value}".')
    if v < 1:
        v = 1
    if v > 100:
        v = 100
    opts.delay = v


def set_max_iterations(opts: Opts, value: str) -> None:
    v = parse_initial_int(value)
    if v is None:
        raise CliError(f'Error: invalid maximum iteration count "{value}".')
    if v <= 0:
        raise CliError("Error: maximum iteration count must be positive.")
    opts.max_iterations = v


def set_highlight(opts: Opts, value: str | None) -> None:
    opts.highlight_changes = True
    if value is None:
        return
    v = parse_initial_int(value)
    if v is None:
        raise CliError(f'Error: invalid highlight delay value "{value}".')
    opts.highlight_delay = v


def set_filter(opts: Opts, value: str) -> None:
    if value == "":
        raise CliError('Error: invalid filter value "".')
    opts.filter = value


def set_user(opts: Opts, value: str | None) -> None:
    if value is None:
        value = os.environ.get("USER") or pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
    opts.user = value
    if value == "":
        raise CliError('Error: invalid user "".')
    if value.isdigit():
        opts.uid = int(value)
        return
    try:
        opts.uid = pwd.getpwnam(value).pw_uid
    except KeyError:

def set_sort(opts: Opts, value: str) -> None:
    if value == "help":
        sys.stdout.write(SORT_TEXT)
        raise ImmediateExit(0)
    if value not in VALID_COLUMNS:
        raise CliError(f'Error: invalid column "{value}".')
    opts.sort_key = value


def apply_option(opts: Opts, canonical: str, arg: str | None) -> None:
    if canonical == "help":
        sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT)
        raise ImmediateExit(0)
    if canonical == "version":
        sys.stdout.write(VERSION + "\n")
        raise ImmediateExit(0)
    if canonical == "no-color":
        opts.no_color = True
    elif canonical == "delay":
        set_delay(opts, arg if arg is not None else "")
    elif canonical == "filter":
        set_filter(opts, arg if arg is not None else "")
    elif canonical == "no-function-bar":
        opts.no_function_bar = True
    elif canonical == "highlight-changes":
        set_highlight(opts, arg)
    elif canonical == "no-mouse":
        opts.no_mouse = True
    elif canonical == "no-meters":
        opts.no_meters = True
    elif canonical == "max-iterations":
        set_max_iterations(opts, arg if arg is not None else "")
    elif canonical == "pid":
        opts.pids_raw = arg if arg is not None else ""
    elif canonical == "readonly":
        opts.readonly = True
    elif canonical == "sort-key":
        set_sort(opts, arg if arg is not None else "")
    elif canonical == "tree":
        opts.tree = True
    elif canonical == "user":
        set_user(opts, arg)
    elif canonical == "no-unicode":
        opts.no_unicode = True


def long_matches(name: str):
    raw = [(canon, longname, kind) for canon, longname, kind, _ in LONG_OPTIONS if longname.startswith(name)]
    # Exact match wins, including aliases.
    exact = [m for m in raw if m[1] == name]
    if exact:
        raw = exact
    # Options that share the same canonical action are aliases and not ambiguous.
    canons = []
    for c, _l, _k in raw:
        if c not in canons:
            canons.append(c)
    return raw, canons


def ambiguity_list(name: str) -> list[str]:
    vals = [longname for _c, longname, _k, _s in LONG_OPTIONS if longname.startswith(name)]
    if name in ("n", "no", "no-") or name.startswith("no-"):
        ordered = [x for x in AMBIG_ORDER if x in vals]
        rest = [x for x in vals if x not in ordered]
        return ordered + rest
    return vals


def resolve_long(argv0: str, token: str):
    body = token[2:]
    if "=" in body:
        name, attached = body.split("=", 1)
        has_attached = True
    else:
        name, attached = body, None
        has_attached = False
    raw, canons = long_matches(name)
    if not raw:
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: unrecognized option '{token}'")
    if len(canons) > 1:
        poss = " ".join(f"'--{x}'" for x in ambiguity_list(name))
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option '{token}' is ambiguous; possibilities: {poss}")
    # Prefer exact/first spelling for diagnostics.
    canon = canons[0]
    selected = raw[0]
    # If several aliases match, use exact if present otherwise first listed.
    for m in raw:
        if m[1] == name:
            selected = m
            break
    _canon, longname, kind = selected
    if has_attached and kind == 0:
        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option '--{longname}' doesn't allow an argument")
    return canon, longname, kind, has_attached, attached


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Opts, list[str]]:
    argv0 = argv[0] if argv else "./executable"
    opts = Opts()
    nonopts: list[str] = []
    i = 1
    after_double_dash = False
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if after_double_dash:
            nonopts.append(a)
            i += 1
            continue
        if a == "--":
            after_double_dash = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if a.startswith("--") and len(a) > 2:
            canon, longname, kind, has_attached, attached = resolve_long(argv0, a)
            if kind == 1:
                if has_attached:
                    arg = attached
                else:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option '--{longname}' requires an argument")
                    i += 1
                    arg = argv[i]
                apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
            elif kind == 2:
                if has_attached:
                    arg = attached
                elif i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                    i += 1
                    arg = argv[i]
                else:
                    arg = None
                apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
            else:
                apply_option(opts, canon, None)
            i += 1
            continue
        if a.startswith("-") and a != "-":
            cluster = a[1:]
            pos = 0
            consumed_next = False
            while pos < len(cluster):
                ch = cluster[pos]
                if ch not in "CdFhHMnpsuUtV":
                    raise CliError(f"{argv0}: invalid option -- '{ch}'")
                # Immediate no-arg options.
                if ch in "CMhtUV":
                    canon = {
                        "C": "no-color", "M": "no-mouse", "h": "help",
                        "t": "tree", "U": "no-unicode", "V": "version",
                    }[ch]
                    apply_option(opts, canon, None)
                    pos += 1
                    continue
                if ch in "dFnps":
                    if pos + 1 < len(cluster):
                        arg = cluster[pos + 1:]
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    else:
                        if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                            raise CliError(f"{argv0}: option requires an argument -- '{ch}'")
                        i += 1
                        arg = argv[i]
                        consumed_next = True
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    canon = {"d": "delay", "F": "filter", "n": "max-iterations", "p": "pid", "s": "sort-key"}[ch]
                    apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
                    continue
                if ch in "Hu":
                    if pos + 1 < len(cluster):
                        arg = cluster[pos + 1:]
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    elif i + 1 < len(argv) and not argv[i + 1].startswith("-"):
                        i += 1
                        arg = argv[i]
                        consumed_next = True
                        pos = len(cluster)
                    else:
                        arg = None
                        pos += 1
                    canon = {"H": "highlight-changes", "u": "user"}[ch]
                    apply_option(opts, canon, arg)
                    continue
            i += 1
            continue
        nonopts.append(a)
        i += 1
    return opts, nonopts


def check_terminal() -> bool:
    term = os.environ.get("TERM") or "unknown"
    return term != "unknown"


def color(opts: Opts, code: str, text: str) -> str:
    if opts.no_color:
        return text
    return f"\033[{code}m{text}\033[39m"


def attr(opts: Opts, code: str, text: str) -> str:
    if opts.no_color:
        return text
    return f"\033[{code}m{text}\033[0m"


def read_meminfo():
    vals = {}
    try:
        with open("/proc/meminfo", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    vals[parts[0].rstrip(":")] = int(parts[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    total = vals.get("MemTotal", 0)
    avail = vals.get("MemAvailable", vals.get("MemFree", 0))
    used = max(0, total - avail)
    swapt = vals.get("SwapTotal", 0)
    swapf = vals.get("SwapFree", 0)
    swapu = max(0, swapt - swapf)
    return total, used, swapt, swapu


def human_k(kb: int) -> str:
    if kb >= 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{kb / (1024*1024):.1f}T" if kb >= 1024*1024*1024 else f"{kb/(1024*1024):.1f}G"
    if kb >= 1024:
        return f"{kb/1024:.1f}G" if kb >= 1024*1024 else f"{kb//1024}M"
    return f"{kb}K"


def compact_k(kb: int) -> str:
    if kb < 100000:
        return str(kb)
    if kb < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{kb//1024}M"
    return f"{kb/(1024*1024):.1f}G"


def uptime_text() -> str:
    try:
        secs = int(float(open("/proc/uptime", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()[0]))
    except Exception:
        secs = 0
    days, rem = divmod(secs, 86400)
    h, rem = divmod(rem, 3600)
    m, _s = divmod(rem, 60)
    if days:
        return f"{days} days, {h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:00"


def loadavg_text() -> str:
    try:
        p = open("/proc/loadavg", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()
        return f"{float(p[0]):.2f} {float(p[1]):.2f} {float(p[2]):.2f}"
    except Exception:
        return "0.00 0.00 0.00"


def pid_filter_set(raw: str | None):
    if raw is None:
        return None
    out = set()
    for item in raw.split(','):
        try:
            if item.strip():
                out.add(int(item))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return out


def parse_stat(pid: int):
    data = open(f"/proc/{pid}/stat", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    r = data.rfind(")")
    l = data.find("(")
    comm = data[l+1:r] if l != -1 and r != -1 else str(pid)
    parts = data[r+2:].split()
    return comm, parts


def read_status_uid(pid: int):
    try:
        with open(f"/proc/{pid}/status", "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.startswith("Uid:"):
                    return int(line.split()[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    return -1


def username(uid: int) -> str:
    try:
        return pwd.getpwuid(uid).pw_name[:8]
    except Exception:
        return str(uid)[:8]


def cmdline(pid: int, comm: str) -> str:
    try:
        b = open(f"/proc/{pid}/cmdline", "rb").read()
        if b:
            return b.replace(b"\0", b" ").decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return comm


def time_field(ticks: int) -> str:
    hz = os.sysconf(os.sysconf_names.get('SC_CLK_TCK', 'SC_CLK_TCK')) if hasattr(os, 'sysconf') else 100
    hundredths = int(ticks * 100 / (hz or 100))
    sec = hundredths // 100
    hs = hundredths % 100
    m, s = divmod(sec, 60)
    h, m = divmod(m, 60)
    if h:
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
    return f"{m}:{s:02d}.{hs:02d}"


def collect_processes(opts: Opts):
    pfilter = pid_filter_set(opts.pids_raw)
    total_mem, _used, _swapt, _swapu = read_meminfo()
    pagesize = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE") // 1024
    rows = []
    for name in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not name.isdigit():
            continue
        pid = int(name)
        if pfilter is not None and pid not in pfilter:
            continue
        try:
            comm, st = parse_stat(pid)
            state = st[0]
            ppid = int(st[1])
            priority = int(st[15])
            nice = int(st[16])
            threads = int(st[17])
            utime = int(st[11]); stime = int(st[12])
            vsize_kb = int(st[20]) // 1024
            rss_kb = int(st[21]) * pagesize
            statm = open(f"/proc/{pid}/statm", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()
            shr_kb = int(statm[2]) * pagesize if len(statm) > 2 else 0
            uid = read_status_uid(pid)
            if opts.uid is not None and uid != opts.uid:
                continue
            command = cmdline(pid, comm)
            if opts.filter:
                terms = [t.lower() for t in opts.filter.split('|') if t]
                if terms and not any(t in command.lower() for t in terms):
                    continue
            mempct = (rss_kb / total_mem * 100.0) if total_mem else 0.0
            rows.append({
                "pid": pid, "ppid": ppid, "user": username(uid), "pri": priority,
                "nice": nice, "virt": vsize_kb, "res": rss_kb, "shr": shr_kb,
                "state": state, "cpu": 0.0, "mem": mempct,
                "time": time_field(utime + stime), "command": command,
                "threads": threads,
            })
        except Exception:
            continue
    key = opts.sort_key or "PID"
    if key == "PERCENT_MEM":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["mem"], r["pid"]))
    elif key in ("PERCENT_CPU", "PERCENT_NORM_CPU"):
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["cpu"], r["pid"]))
    elif key == "USER":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["user"], r["pid"]))
    elif key == "Command":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["command"].lower(), r["pid"]))
    elif key == "TIME":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["time"], r["pid"]))
    else:
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["pid"])
    return rows


def process_counts(rows):
    tasks = len(rows)
    running = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("state") == "R")
    threads = sum(max(0, r.get("threads", 1) - 1) for r in rows)
    return tasks, threads, running


def strip_ansi_len(s: str) -> int:
    n = 0; esc = False; bracket = False
    for ch in s:
        if esc:
            if bracket:
                if ch.isalpha() or ch in "@`~":
                    esc = bracket = False
            else:
                if ch == '[':
                    bracket = True
                else:
                    esc = False
        elif ch == '\033':
            esc = True
        else:
            n += 1
    return n


def pad_cut(s: str, width: int) -> str:
    # Keep it simple: process rows have no ANSI sequences.
    if len(s) > width:
        return s[:width]
    return s + " " * (width - len(s))


def bar(percent: float, width: int, opts: Opts) -> str:
    filled = max(0, min(width, int(width * percent / 100.0)))
    ch = "|" if not opts.no_unicode else "#"
    empty = " " * (width - filled)
    return color(opts, "32", ch * filled) + (color(opts, "30;1", empty) if not opts.no_color else empty)


def render_frame(opts: Opts, rows, frame_no: int) -> str:
    cols, lines = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
    if cols < 40:
        cols = 80
    out = []
    out.append("\033[H")
    out.append("\033[J")
    total, used, swapt, swapu = read_meminfo()
    tasks, threads, running = process_counts(rows)
    line_no = 1
    if not opts.no_meters:
        cpu_pct = 0.0
        try:
            la = float(open("/proc/loadavg", "r", encoding="ascii").read().split()[0])
            cpus = os.cpu_count() or 1
            cpu_pct = max(0.0, min(100.0, la * 100.0 / cpus))
        except Exception:
            pass
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Avg')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(cpu_pct, 28, opts)}{cpu_pct:4.1f}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Tasks: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(tasks))}{color(opts,'36',', ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(threads))}{color(opts,'36',' thr')}{color(opts,'36',f'; ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',str(running))}{color(opts,'36',' running')}\033[K\n")
        mempct = used * 100.0 / total if total else 0.0
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Mem')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(mempct, 28, opts)}{human_k(used)}/{human_k(total)}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Load average: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',loadavg_text())}\033[K\n")
        swppct = swapu * 100.0 / swapt if swapt else 0.0
        out.append(f"  {color(opts,'36','Swp')}{attr(opts,'0;1','[')}{bar(swppct, 28, opts)}{human_k(swapu)}/{human_k(swapt)}{attr(opts,'0;1',']')} ")
        out.append(f"{color(opts,'36','Uptime: ')}{attr(opts,'0;1',uptime_text())}\033[K\n")
        out.append("\033[K\n")
        line_no = 5
    if not opts.no_function_bar:
        out.append(f"  {attr(opts,'32;42','[Main]')} {attr(opts,'34;44','[I/O]')}\033[K\n")
        line_no += 1
    sortmark = "-" if (opts.sort_key in (None, "PERCENT_CPU")) else "+"
    header = f"  PID USER       PRI  NI  VIRT   RES   SHR S  CPU%{sortmark}MEM%   TIME+  Command"
    if opts.no_color:
        out.append(pad_cut(header, cols) + "\n")
    else:
        out.append("\033[30;42m" + pad_cut(header, cols) + "\033[39;49m\n")
    max_rows = lines - line_no - (2 if not opts.no_function_bar else 1)
    if max_rows < 1:
        max_rows = 1
    for idx, r in enumerate(rows[:max_rows]):
        cmd = r['command']
        if opts.tree and r['ppid'] != 0:
            cmd = ("`- " if opts.no_unicode else "└─ ") + cmd
        line = (f"{r['pid']:5d} {r['user']:<8.8s} {r['pri']:4d} {r['nice']:3d} "
                f"{compact_k(r['virt']):>5.5s} {compact_k(r['res']):>5.5s} {compact_k(r['shr']):>5.5s} "
                f"{r['state']:<1s} {r['cpu']:5.1f} {r['mem']:4.1f} {r['time']:>8.8s}  {cmd}")
        line = pad_cut(line, cols)
        if idx == 0 and not opts.no_color:
            out.append("\033[30;46m" + line + "\033[39;49m\n")
        else:
            out.append(line + "\n")
    if not opts.no_function_bar:
        # Position a htop-style function bar at the last line.
        out.append(f"\033[{lines};1H")
        labels = [("F1","Help"),("F2","Setup"),("F3","Search"),("F4","Filter"),("F5","Tree"),("F6","SortBy"),("F7","Nice -"),("F8","Nice +"),("F9","Kill"),("F10","Quit")]
        fb = ""
        for f, lab in labels:
            if opts.no_color:
                fb += f"{f}{lab} "
            else:
                fb += f"\033[30;46m{f}\033[39;49m\033[34;47m{lab}\033[39;49m"
        out.append(pad_cut(fb, cols))
    out.append("\033[H")
    return "".join(out)


def render_help_screen(opts: Opts) -> str:
    cols, lines = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24))
    text = [
        "htop Help", "", "Available keys:",
        "  F1 h ?   Show this help screen", "  q F10    Quit",
        "  F5 t     Tree view", "  F6 .     Sort by column", "",
        "Press q or Escape to return.", "", VERSION,
    ]
    out = ["\033[H\033[J"]
    for line in text[:lines-1]:
        out.append(pad_cut(line, cols) + "\n")
    return "".join(out)


def terminal_main(opts: Opts) -> int:
    if not check_terminal():
        eprint("Error opening terminal: unknown.")
        return 1
    delay_s = max(0.1, min(10.0, opts.delay / 10.0))
    iterations = opts.max_iterations
    interactive = sys.stdin.isatty()
    old_term = None
    if interactive:
        try:
            old_term = termios.tcgetattr(sys.stdin.fileno())
            tty.setcbreak(sys.stdin.fileno())
        except Exception:
            old_term = None
    try:
        sys.stdout.write("\033[?1049h\033[22;0;0t\033[1;24r\033(B\033[m\033[4l\033[?7h\033[H\033[2J\033[?1h\033=\033[?25l\033[39;49m")
        if not opts.no_mouse:
            sys.stdout.write("\033[?1006;1000h")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        frame = 0
        help_mode = False
        while True:
            frame += 1
            if help_mode:
                sys.stdout.write(render_help_screen(opts))
            else:
                rows = collect_processes(opts)
                sys.stdout.write(render_frame(opts, rows, frame))
            sys.stdout.flush()
            if iterations is not None and frame >= iterations:
                break
            end = time.time() + delay_s
            while True:
                timeout = max(0.0, end - time.time())
                if interactive:
                    try:
                        r, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], min(timeout, 0.1))
                    except Exception:
                        r = []
                    if r:
                        ch = os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 16).decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
                        if ch in ('q', 'Q') or ch.endswith('q') or ch == '\x1b[21~':
                            return 0
                        if ch in ('h', '?', '\x1bOP') or ch.startswith('\x1bOP'):
                            help_mode = not help_mode
                            break
                        if help_mode and ('\x1b' in ch or 'q' in ch):
                            help_mode = False
                            break
                        if 't' in ch:
                            opts.tree = not opts.tree
                            break
                else:
                    time.sleep(timeout)
                if time.time() >= end:
                    break
        return 0
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 0
    finally:
        try:
            sys.stdout.write("\033[?12l\033[?25h")
            if not opts.no_mouse:
                sys.stdout.write("\033[?1006;1000l")
            sys.stdout.write("\033[24;1H\n\033[?1l\033>\033[?1049l\033[23;0;0t")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if old_term is not None:
            try:
                termios.tcsetattr(sys.stdin.fileno(), termios.TCSADRAIN, old_term)
            except Exception:
                pass


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        opts, nonopts = parse_args(argv)
        if nonopts:
            raise CliError("Error: unsupported non-option ARGV-elements: " + " ".join(nonopts))
        return terminal_main(opts)
    except ImmediateExit as ex:
        return ex.code
    except CliError as ex:
        eprint(str(ex))
        return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
